CE-001.authority_or_effect: Instrument rows, mark inputs and source clock reach Cap21. The upstream acquisition does not authorize selection.

CE-002.authority_or_effect: The typed USDC result is scoped to account and decision time before binding. Venue equity and local commitments remain distinct.

CE-003.authority_or_effect: This is a static check and feeds policy eligibility. The separately verified simulated POST cannot grant policy admission.
CE-003.direction: Pre-external proof -> Full Core source inspection

CE-004.authority_or_effect: Static proof reads the core path; no returned proof becomes a core trade signal here.

CE-005.authority_or_effect: Presentation uses the read-model endpoint. It does not write trading state.
CE-005.direction: Public-MD read model -> GET route -> browser

CE-006.authority_or_effect: The source arrow follows the call. The public bootstrap and publication results flow back.
CE-006.direction: Convergence -> Public Runtime; public facts -> Convergence

CE-007.authority_or_effect: The source arrow follows the call. Restored account state, baseline and reconciliation return to the caller.
CE-007.direction: Convergence -> Private Runtime; account state -> Convergence

CE-008.authority_or_effect: The selected instrument and generation are preserved. The validator checks identity and does not select again.
CE-008.direction: Cap23 selection -> Cap24 bound identity; N1 -> validator

CE-009.authority_or_effect: Core consumes instrument-bound volatility with warmup and provenance. Presence alone does not prove productive operation.
CE-009.direction: Typed G17 observation -> canonical market context

c1_injected_governed_cycle.authority_or_effect: Finality and native instrument bind the C1 observation. Invalid input blocks the next stage.
c1_injected_governed_cycle.direction: Cycle -> C1 mapper; mapped observation -> cycle

fa_compose_governed_cycle_n1.authority_or_effect: Invocation and response differ in direction. The observed composition is bounded and disables network execution.
fa_compose_governed_cycle_n1.direction: Readiness -> N1 cycle; cycle result -> Readiness

fa_compose_portfolio_budget.authority_or_effect: The reference travels into the join; the original budget owner retains reservation authority and persistence.

intent_to_execution.authority_or_effect: Intent alone cannot be sent; the final envelope, permit, durable attempt and bound transport are separate.

k1_bind_governed_cycle_occupancy.authority_or_effect: The consumer checks the no-material-loaded status. A bind result grants no send authority.
k1_bind_governed_cycle_occupancy.direction: Cycle -> K1 binder; bind status -> cycle

mv2_executable_pre_external_terminal.authority_or_effect: The cycle can emit a plan and stop. An order attempt requires its own downstream authority.

mv2_to_sizing.authority_or_effect: Decision, monetary basis and size constraints go to the sizer; the budget owner alone persists any hold.

mv2_valid_no_trade_terminal.authority_or_effect: HOLD_CLOSED ends the cycle without POST. Quantity rejection is a separate outcome.

reconciliation_startup_before_cap24_bind.authority_or_effect: A hard stop or disabled alpha blocks binding; the startup reader does not choose the instrument.
reconciliation_startup_before_cap24_bind.direction: Cap24 -> startup reconciliation; reconciliation status -> Cap24
